R325.note: Moves deletion from GET to POST with {% csrf_token %}, the canonical Django CSRF fix for a state-changing GET; the GET-now-shows-confirmation behavior change is inherent to the fix and openly stated.

R326.note: Standard JdbcTemplate parameterized query with ? placeholder and varargs binding; return type/contract unchanged.

R327.note: path.basename() plus res.sendFile(filename, {root}) is the canonical Express fix; reportsDir is a flat directory per the case comment so no legitimate path is broken.

R328.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML strips scripts/handlers while default config preserves ordinary formatting markup.

R329.note: Magic-byte detection against an allowlist plus a server-generated filename/extension is the canonical CWE-434 fix; response shape is unchanged, the stored filename differing from the original is an inherent, intended consequence of the fix.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks-based canonical-path containment check matches the stated contract (regular in-dir files still read, escaping symlinks rejected); minor nuance that a nonexistent-name lookup now returns os.ErrPermission instead of the original I/O error, not otherwise impactful.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity correctly reactivates the inert @PreAuthorize checks, but the write-up also invents new authorization rules (self-account-deletion, admin-cannot-suspend-self) not called for by the finding, changing who can successfully call an admin endpoint beyond the minimal fix; disclosed but out of scope.

R332.note: Verified with PHP 8.5/libxml by running both flag variants against a file:// entity payload: removing LIBXML_NOENT is what actually stops the file leak (confirmed), legitimate title/body extraction is unaffected; the write-up's stated rationale (that LIBXML_NONET blocks the file:// read) is factually wrong per the same test -- NOENT+NONET together still leaked -- but the shipped code change works regardless.

R333.note: Standard SqlCommand parameterized query with explicit NVarChar type; apostrophes remain literal data per the stated contract.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) exactly implements the stated contract for present vs. absent SKUs.

R335.note: java.nio.file.Path resolve+normalize+startsWith containment check correctly rejects traversal and absolute-path payloads (resolve() replaces on absolute input) while preserving normal writes.

R336.note: Removes shell invocation and validates host against an IP/hostname allowlist that requires a leading alnum, which also closes leading-hyphen flag injection into traceroute; legitimate hosts unaffected.

R337.note: Removes the tainted argsEnv parameter entirely rather than validating it; this OWASP Benchmark case has no legitimate functional use for that parameter so nothing is broken.

R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before bypassSecurityTrustHtml preserves default-allowed formatting tags (b, em, a) while stripping script vectors, matching the stated contract.
